verdict.rationale: The evidence includes a static availability page, but its only quoted content says CPU machines exist in all regions. It also notes that high-end GPUs like the H100 require approval. Nothing shows real-time GPU availability or stock levels by type and region before provisioning, so this is adjacent documentation rather than the capability.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see real-time GPU availability by type and region before I try to provision, instead of discovering stockouts by failure
